outcome: A parked implementation cycle recovers with one retry: a derived work whose own epoch holds no attempts follows its parent cycle's retry epoch - the inheritance the journal's own comment already promises - and the board offers exactly one retry action per parked cycle, so the seal/dispatch epoch-skew wedge becomes unreachable instead of unwinnable.

exclude: journal schema changes or migration of recorded journals (existing journal files stay readable, their recorded epochs stay valid)
automatic retries (retry remains an explicit operator command)
relaxing three-try exhaustion for the work actually retried

acceptance.text: The r4 wedge is the regression corpus: a journal fixture holding a seal-cycle work and its derived dispatch work both OperationalFailed at try 3 of epoch 1 accepts one retry of the cycle work, after which attempt admission for the derived work at the new epoch succeeds - read back from the journal effects table with no STALE_RETRY_EPOCH - pinned in internal/journal/store_test.go.

A parked cycle surfaces exactly one retry action, the cycle work, with no second action for its derived work: pinned by the projector action-set fixture in internal/cockpit/projector_test.go and the parked-set fixture over internal/runtime's status read path.

Existing epoch protections hold unmodified: TestRetryEpochRequiresExactThreeTryExhaustion in internal/journal/store_test.go passes as written - superseded epochs still refuse STALE_RETRY_EPOCH and an unexhausted work still refuses WORK_NOT_EXHAUSTED.

The real-binary park-and-retry scenario recovers with the single cycle retry: the parked-lane recovery case in test/e2e/topology_recovery_linux_test.go, declared as CI evidence (ADR 0010), not executed by any role.

constraints: No journal schema change and no migration: the fix is admission semantics over the existing effects and commands tables; journals recorded before this slice remain readable unmodified.
Error codes are never renamed; STALE_RETRY_EPOCH and WORK_NOT_EXHAUSTED keep their meanings for the work actually retried.
